slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
dangerously confident

doing the talking

next time a group has to present, be the one who says "i'll do the talking". the nerves only last two minutes, and the reputation you build lasts the whole year.

giving credit out loud

in every meeting this week, name one person who did good work, out loud. people who give credit freely look like leaders, and nobody ever suspects them of being insecure.

one real question up

once a week, ask your boss or teacher one real question about how they think, not about the task. most people only talk up when they need something, and that's why they stay invisible.

coffee break facts

use one coffee break a day to learn something new in 5 minutes: a piece of history, a science fact, a famous artwork. bringing something interesting back to the room makes people want you around.

owning a deadline

say out loud when you'll finish something, then finish it a little early. a short streak of kept promises at work does more for your confidence than any compliment ever will.
